The search result explicitly stated the parents were John the Fearless (Duke of Burgundy) and Margaret of Bavaria. John the Fearless was a powerful Duke of Burgundy who lived during a period when the Duchy was a separate entity from the Kingdom of France (which he actually fought against). The Planner incorrectly classified his nationality as 'Burgundian (Holy Roman Empire)' or implied a complex HRE affiliation, missing the clear historical fact that John the Fearless was of French nationality (as he ruled a French-speaking duchy and was a primary player in the Wars of the Burgundian Succession against the French Crown). This error led directly to the wrong final answer 'Burgundian (Holy Roman Empire)' instead of the correct answer 'France'.
